features.headline: Your store, operated automatically
features.sub: An AI agent manages your orders, responds to customers and makes real-time decisions — without human intervention.
items: Automatic replies to frequently asked questions

features.headline: Every product page, built to sell
features.sub: We don't just generate a site. We analyze your business, understand the buyer journey and build page structure around a single goal: conversion.
items: Full SEO per product — schema.org JSON-LD, meta tags, Google-indexable
CTAs positioned based on conversion psychology, not visual preferences
Page structure generated by product type and audience
Analytics loop: sees what doesn't convert and recommends adjustments

features.headline: Your data, in real time
features.sub: Complete dashboard with all the important metrics — sales, conversions, new customers, top products. No setup required.

features.headline: Stock always up to date
features.sub: Merx tracks every product and alerts you when restocking is needed, before you run out of stock.

features.headline: All orders, in one place
features.sub: View, filter and process orders from the dashboard — with clear statuses, complete timeline and fulfillment in a few clicks.
items: Real-time status: placed → processed → shipped → delivered
Filter by date, status, customer, value
Automatic customer notification on every status change

features.headline: Know your customers
features.sub: CRM integrated directly in the platform — complete customer profile, total spend, order history and new vs. returning segmentation.
items: Customer profile with all orders and LTV value
Quick search by email or name

features.headline: Campaigns and promo codes
features.sub: Create promo codes in seconds — percentage or fixed discount, usage limit, minimum cart value. Customers apply them directly at checkout.
items: Promo code with % or fixed discount
Maximum number of uses per code
Usage report — how many customers used the code
